<fidel-caption-report>

Report a caption problem. Learners tell staff when a caption is wrong; the report arrives in Fidel Studio on the lesson's page.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Every learner, especially Deaf learners who notice a wrong Amharic caption.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Loading the lesson video…

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-player id="lesson-player" lesson="https://YOUR-FIDEL-HOST/api/v1/lessons/LESSON_ID"></fidel-player>
<fidel-caption-report for="lesson-player"></fidel-caption-report>

Source: player/src/components/d/caption-report.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-caption-report>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
forid of a <fidel-player>the first <fidel-player> on the pageThe player this component works with.
apiURLfrom the player's lesson URL, else /api/v1The Fidel API.
lessonidfrom the player's lesson URLThe lesson id.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-caption-report>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-caption-report-sent{ lessonId, time, lang }The report reached the server.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • The dialog already holds the current time, the caption language and the caption shown. "What is wrong?" is a group of radio buttons; a correction is optional.
  • The video pauses while the dialog is open; Escape closes it and the video plays on.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded): Learners can report wrong or missing captions and missing sound descriptions.
  • 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: "What is wrong?" is a <fieldset> with a <legend>.
  • 4.1.3 Status Messages: "Thank you. A person will check it." and "Saved on this phone…" are announced.
  • No name, no account. Offline, the report is kept on the phone and sent when it is back online.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
